newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA APR-DEC EXCHEQUER RECEIPTS 108.3 BLN RAND.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA APR-DEC EXCHEQUER RECEIPTS 108.3 BLN RAND.

text.p: Total exchequer receipts in
the first nine months of the 1996/97 (April-March) financial
year were 108.296 billion rand -- an increase of 17.1 percent
compared to 1995, the Finance Department said on Friday.
During April to December 1996, 74.7 percent of the budgeted
144.9 billion rand was received compared to 72.7 percent of the
budgeted 127.3 billion rand for the same period in 1995.
During December 1996 financing of 1.59 billion rand was
obtained in government bonds, while short term loans (net)
decreased by 1.22 billion rand, bringing the total financing for
December 1996 to 372.7 million rand.
Government bonds and debentures amounting to 15.73 billion
rand and foreign loans to the amount of 750 million rand were
redeemed during April to December 1996.
The overall Exchequer balance on December 31 was 639.2
million rand. If the balance in the Tax and Loans Accounts is
included, the figure amounts to 6.79 billion rand, the
department said.
